# Job Chapter 5 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 417v–418r

---

**5:1** "Call now — is-there [ha-yesh] one-who-answers-you [onekha]?
And-to which of-the-holy-ones [qedoshim] will-you-turn [tifneh]?

**5:2** For the-fool [evil] — anger [ka'as] kills-him [tahargennu],
and-the-simple-one [poteh] — jealousy [qin'ah] slays-him [temitehu].

**5:3** I have-seen [ra'itiy] a-fool [evil] taking-root [mashrish],
and-I-cursed [va-eqqov] his-dwelling [navehu] suddenly [pit'om].

**5:4** Far are his-sons [banav] from-safety [mi-yesha],
and-they-are-crushed [yiddakke'u] in-the-gate [ba-sha'ar] and-there-is-no deliverer [mattsil].

**5:5** Whose harvest [qetsiro] the-hungry [ra'ev] eats [yokhel],
and-even from-among thorns [tsannim] he-takes-it [yiqqachehu],
and-the-snare [tsammim] swallows [sha'af] their-wealth [cheilam].

**5:6** For not from-the-dust [me-afar] comes-forth [yetse] iniquity [aven],
and-not from-the-ground [me-adamah] sprouts [yitsmach] trouble [amal].

**5:7** For man [adam] is-born [yullad] to-trouble [la-amal],
and-the-sons of-the-flame [benei reshef] fly [yagbihu] upward [uf].

**5:8** But I — to God [el] I-would-seek [edrosh],
and-to God [elohim] I-would-set [asim] my-cause [dibbratiy].

**5:9** Who-does [oseh] great-things [gedolot] and-unsearchable [ve-ein cheqer],
wonders [nifla'ot] until there-is-no number [ad ein mispar].

**5:10** Who-gives [ha-noten] rain [matar] upon the-face of-the-earth [erets],
and-sends [ve-sholeach] waters [mayim] upon the-face of-the-fields [chutsot].

**5:11** To-set [lasum] the-lowly [shefalim] on-high [le-marom],
and-mourners [qoderim] are-lifted [sag'vu] to-safety [yesha].

**5:12** He-frustrates [mefer] the-plans [machshevot] of-the-crafty [arumim],
and-their-hands cannot-achieve [lo ta'asenah] success [tushiyyah].

**5:13** He-catches [loked] the-wise [chakhamim] in-their-craftiness [be-ormam],
and-the-counsel [atsat] of-the-twisted [niftalim] is-swept-away [nimharah].

**5:14** By-day [yomam] they-encounter [yefagshu] darkness [choshekh],
and-at-noonday [ka-tsahorayim] they-grope [yemashehu] as-in-the-night [ka-laylah].

**5:15** And-he-saves [vayosha] from-the-sword [me-cherev] from-their-mouth [mi-pihem],
and-from-the-hand of-the-strong [chazaq] the-needy [evyon].

**5:16** And-there-is [va-tehi] hope [tiqvah] for-the-poor [la-dal],
and-injustice [olatah] shuts [qafetsah] its-mouth [piha].

**5:17** Behold, blessed [ashrei] is-the-man [enosh] whom God [eloah] reproves [yokichennu];
and-the-discipline [musar] of-Shaddai [the Almighty] do-not despise [timas].

**5:18** For he wounds [yakh'iv] and-he-binds-up [yechabbesh];
he-strikes [yimchats] and-his-hands [yadav] heal [tirpenah].

**5:19** In-six [be-shesh] troubles [tsarot] he-will-deliver-you [yatsilelekha],
and-in-seven [u-ve-sheva] no-evil [ra] shall-touch-you [yigga bakh].

**5:20** In-famine [be-ra'av] he-will-redeem-you [padekha] from-death [mi-mavet],
and-in-war [be-milchamah] from-the-power of-the-sword [mi-yedei charev].

**5:21** From-the-lash [be-shot] of-the-tongue [lashon] you-will-be-hidden [techave],
and-you-will-not fear [lo tira] destruction [mi-shod] when-it-comes [ki yavo].

**5:22** At-destruction [le-shod] and-at-famine [u-le-khafan] you-will-laugh [tischaq],
and-from-the-beasts [me-chayyat] of-the-earth [ha-arets] you-will-not fear.

**5:23** For with-the-stones of-the-field [avnei ha-sadeh] [is] your-covenant [beritekha],
and-the-beasts of-the-field [chayyat ha-sadeh] are-at-peace [hushlema] with-you.

**5:24** And-you-will-know [ve-yada'ta] that [there-is] peace [shalom] [in] your-tent [ohlekha],
and-you-will-inspect [u-faqadta] your-dwelling [navekha] and-not miss [ve-lo techeta].

**5:25** And-you-will-know that [is] many [rav] your-seed [zar'ekha],
and-your-offspring [tse'etsa'eykha] like-the-grass [ke-esev] of-the-earth.

**5:26** You-will-come [tavo] in-ripe-age [be-khelach] to-the-grave [elei qaver],
as-goes-up [ka-alot] a-stack-of-grain [gadish] in-its-season [be-itto].

**5:27** Behold this — we-have-searched-it-out [chaqarnuha]; so it-is [ken hiy].
Hear-it [shema'ennah] and-you [atah] — know [da] for-yourself [lakh]."

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.7 — "sons of the flame":** Hebrew *benei reshef* literally means "sons of flame" — likely sparks. Some connect *reshef* to the Canaanite deity of pestilence, but here the image is of sparks flying upward naturally, paralleling the inevitability of human trouble.

**v.13 — "catches the wise in their craftiness":** This verse is quoted by Paul in 1 Corinthians 3:19, making it one of the few Job passages cited in the New Testament. The Hebrew *ormah* ("craftiness") echoes the serpent's *arum* in Genesis 3:1.

**v.17 — "Blessed is the man whom God reproves":** This is the heart of Elifaz's theology — suffering is divine discipline, not punishment. The word *musar* (discipline/correction) carries educational rather than punitive overtones.

---
*— EMET*
